استحقرت (form X)
# اِسْتَحْقَرْتُ (istaḥqartu) /is.taħ.qar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
# اِسْتَحْقَرْتَ (istaḥqarta) /is.taħ.qar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
# اِسْتَحْقَرْتِ (istaḥqarti) /is.taħ.qar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
# اِسْتَحْقَرَتْ (istaḥqarat) /is.t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
